name: Mosquitto
description: Broker MQTT léger pour vos objets connectés (port 1883).
compose:
services:
  mosquitto:
    image: eclipse-mosquitto:2
    container_name: mosquitto
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: mosquitto -c /mosquitto-no-auth.conf
    ports:
      - "1883:1883"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/mosquitto/data
      - {{APPDATA}}/log:/mosquitto/log
